newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER SHOWCASE-LECHKOV WINS BACK PLACE IN MARSEILLE SIDE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-LECHKOV WINS BACK PLACE IN MARSEILLE SIDE.

text.p: Yordan Lechkov, out of favour in recent weeks, will play for Marseille in their French first division match against champions Auxerre on Sunday.

Lechkov, who had a fine game in Marseille's 3-2 League Cup victory over the same opponents at the Velodrome on Tuesday, stands in for captain Jean-Philippe Durand who has failed to recover from a knee injury.
Coach Gerard Gili has gone against his custom of playing home games with a three-man defence by deciding on four at the back.
"This is a completely different match. We must expect a reaction from Auxerre," Gili said on Friday.
Gili's cautious approach gives Englishman Chris Makin a place in the side at right back.
Hamada Jambay, usually the right back, moves across to the left again to mark Auxerre winger Steve Marlet who scored both goals on Tuesday.
Italians Ivan Franceschini and Alberto Malusci are the centre-backs.
This leaves less room in midfield with Ludovic Asuar, the player who displaced Lechkov during Marseille's slump in October, dropped to the bench.
Lechkov lines up with Reynald Pedros and ball winners Eric Roy and Olivier Echouafni in midfield.
Xavier Gravelaine, Marseille's top scorer this season with five goals, returns from suspension to join Marc Libbra up front.
Goalkeeper Andreas Koepke is expected to land in Marseille only a few hours before kickoff after playing for Germany in their World Cup qualifier against Portugal in Lisbon on Saturday.
Auxerre could be strengthened in midfield by Christian Henna, who is recovering from an injury that kept him out his side's last European Champions' League match against Glasgow Rangers.
But coach Guy Roux, who has seldom been able to put out the same side for two successive games this season, will not confirm his line-up until just before the game.
Roux always tries to play with a three-pronged attack which against Marseille on Sunday looks certain to include Marlet and Lilian Laslandes.

But Fabrice Lepaul, who played in the league cup match, could make way for a midfield reshuffle to include Henna and Algerian playmaker Moussa Saib, with his compatriot Abdelfahid Tasfaout as a withdrawn winger.
This would mean utility defender Eric Assati also standing down.
Marseille - Andreas Koepke; Chris Makin, Ivan Franceschini, Alberto Malusci, Hamada Jambay; Yordan Lechkov, Eric Roy, Olivier Echouafni, Reynald Pedros; Marc Libbra, Xavier Gravelaine.

Auxerre (probable) - Fabien Cool; Taribo West, Franck Silvestre, Frederic Danjou, Franck Rabarivony; Abdelhajid Tasfaout, Philippe Violeau, Christian Henna, Moussa Saib; Steve Marlet, Lilian Laslandes.
